newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Meredith buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Meredith buy repeated.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co analyst Rita Zanella said Friday she reiterated a buy recommendation on media company Meredith Corp, calling its planned purchase of four television stations from First Media Television LP a positive move.

--Meredith said the transaction is expected to be dilutive to earnings per share in FY98 and FY99. Zanella said, "Since there aren't any (large-scale) magazines for sale, we've been waiting for Meredith to make a broadcast acquisition for well over a year. At these prices, we can expect to see some dilution. The fall-off in the stock price is expected."
--Meredith was down 1-1/4 at 52-1/4 in NYSE trading
